comments.text: I had paid booking amount of 15,000rs on 9th April for Tata Nexon Fearless plus s under assurance from Acko drive that I will get the car delivered within next 2-3 days since car is readily available. Now that I want the refund my booking amount, since the car is not getting delivered on the assure date, Acko Drive is still asking that the booking amount will be charged with the cancellation charges for doing nothing but wasting time of 4 to 5 days. I have been talking to multiple departments from last 4 to 5 days, including cancellation team, DELIVERY team CRM team insurance team, Car exchange team and it has been a lot of mess talking to all of these executives, telling different dates, different narratives, different promises giving a pathetic experience to the customer who reaches out to echo Drive thinking there will be discounts and hassle free car buying experience, but ends up getting into whole lot of mess of talking to different teams, falls promises, and getting into big big fraud of paying cancellation charges for doing nothing. The showroom dealer, Prerna Motors clearly indicating that the car is not allocated while Acko Drive is still pushing and telling lies on car is allocated on your name, chassis Number is allocated all these lies I have caught red-handed when I spoke to the showroom dealer and there was nothing that was allocated against my name.
